tei:div.tei:p: te| so so skye bo dang slob pa'i gnas skabs na yang yongs su nyams pa'i chos can gyi sa bon la rigs zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sems tsam pa ni/ mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rigs de ni/ thog ma med pa nas brgyud de 'ongs pa chos nyid kyis thob pa skye mched drug gi khyad

（ 90na ） par gang yin pa ste/ zhes pa'i don du bsam nas skye mched drug gi khyad par ro// kun gzhi'i rnam gzhag byed na kun gzhi'i steng gi sa bon no/ /mi byed na yid shes la yod pa'i sa bon rkyen dang phrad na theg pa gsum gang rung gi rtogs pa skye rung gi nus pa'o/ /de la kha cig de thos pa'i rkyen gyis sos pa'i rten nus pa mthu can du gyur pa ni rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs yin la/ rkyen gyis ma sos pa ni rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs yin/ zhes bya'o/ /de ni mi 'thad de/ tshogs lam yan na rang bzhin gnas rigs med par 'gyur zhing*/ gal te yod na yang rigs gnyis mi 'gal bar 'gyur ro/ /'o na de gnyis kyi khyad par ji lta bu zhe na| byang sa las/ rigs gang zhe na/ mdor bsdus na rnam pa gnyis te/ rang bzhin gyis gnas pa dang*/ yang dag par sgrub pa'o/ /de yang rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs ni/ skye mched drug gi khyad par gcig nas gcig tu brgyud de 'ongs pa thog ma med pa'i dus can mtshan nyid kyis thob pa de lta bu yin no// yang dag par sgrub pa'i rigs ni/ sngon dge ba'i rtsa ba goms par byas pa las thob pa gang yin pa de'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /yang kha cig sems gsal zhing rig tsam la rang bzhin du gnas rigs su 'dod pa ni mi 'thad de/ de ni sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la yod pa'i phyir dang*/ rigs chad par 'gyur ba'i sems can mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ /chos nyid 'dus ma byas la yang mi 'thad de/ de ni rkyen gyis khyad par du byar med pas rigs kyi don med pa'i phyir ro/ /des na lugs 'di la/ rigs la 'dus byas kyis khyab par 'dod do/ /dbu ma ltar na/ rigs kyi ngo bo ngos bzung ba dang*/ rigs su 'gyur tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don ni tshig don med pa ste/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub la ni skye ba'am/ yod pa nyid dam med pa nyid yod pa'am dmigs pa ma yin te/

zhes gsungs pa dang*/ 'dir yang byang chub sems dpa' rnam pa bcu gsum po ji skad bshad pa'i chos kyis gzhir gyur pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid kho na la rigs zhes bstan to/ /zhes gsungs pas byang chub sems dpa'i nang gi skye mched drug gis khyad par du byas pa'i chos nyid la rigs su bzhed do/ kha cigadri bcas kyi sems rig cing gsal tsam rang bzhin gnas rigs su 'dod pa yang mi 'thad de/ de ni rgyu rkyen gyis gsar du bcos pa yin pas rang bzhin gyi sgra'i don med pa'i phyir ro/ / dbu ma rtsa ba las/ rang bzhin dag ni bcos min dang*/ /gzhan la ltos pa med pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'dir kho na'i sgra smos pa yang don med par 'gyur ro/ /sems tsam pas 'dod pa'i rang bzhin gnas rigs 'gog pa ni/ 'dus byas la rang bzhin gyi don brjod dgos so/ /zhes 'gog pa （ 60ba ） yang mi 'thad par 'gyur te/ 'phags pas gzhan dag rigs ni skye mched drug gi khyad par yin no/ /de ni rnam pa gnyis te/ thos bsam gyis gsos btab pa'i rkyen gyis yang dag par blangs pa dang*/ der rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs dang*/ rang gi byang chub kyi rgyur gyur pa'i shes pa gsal rig tsam ni/ rang bzhin du gnas pa'o/ /zhes zer ro// de dag gis ni rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs la rang bzhin du brjod pa'i don brjod dgos so/ / zhes 'dus byas yin pa'i phyir rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs su mi 'thad ces pa 'dod/ gal te 'dus byas yin kyang rang gi byang chub kyi rgyu'i rnam grangs tsam yin no zhe na/ rkyen gyis yang dag par blangs pa yang de yin pa nges na de gnyis la don gyi khyad par ci yod/ dbu ma pas chos nyid kyi rnam grangs yin pa la nyes pa 'di med do// yang de dag gi rigs ni btags pa ba yin la/ 'di ni mtshan nyid pa yin no// des na 'di dang 'grig pa ma yin no gsungs so/ /gnyis pa la/ rgyu'i sgo nas rigs su 'gyur tshul ni/

yon tan snga ma des yon tan phyi ma'i rgyu byed pa ni bden pas stong pa'i rigs khyad chos su ldan pas yin no/ /gzhan du na dri ma sems kyi rang bzhin du zhugs pas yon tan gong nas gong du 'phel ba mi srid par 'gyur ro/ /rten gyi sgo nas rigs su 'gyur tshul ni/ da lta yon tan gyi rten byed pa yang bden pas stong pa khyad chos su ldan pas yin no/ / gnyis pa la gnyis/ rigs kyi dbye ba dang*/ rtsod pa spang ba'o/ /dang po la snga rtsa 'grel gsum las/ dang po ni/ sbyor lam gyi rjes su sgrub pa'i rten du gyur pa'i rigs gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rten chos sgrub pa dang ldan pa la sngar ji skad bshad pa'i nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa dang*/ mthong ba'i lam la sogs pa gzhan yang 'byung bas so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ / bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes bgyi ba'i tshig 'di'i don gang lags/ zhes pa nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos thams cad rtogs par bya'o zhes pa'i bar gyis ni sgrub pa'i rten bstan to/ /de dag gi don bsdus nas ston pa ni/ rtogs pa yi ni chos drug gi rten la rigs zhes bya'o/ /zhes sbyar ro/ /de bzhin du gnyen po bar chad med lam dang*/ spong ba rnam grol gyi lam dang*/ spang gnyen de dag yongs su gtugs pa ste khyad par gyi lam dang*/ shes rab dang snying rtser bcas pa'i sgrub pa dang*/ slob ma nyan thos dang thun mongs ma yin pa'i sgrub pa dang skal ba dang mtshams par gzhan gyi don gyi go rim gyis 'jug pa dang*/ ye shes rtsol ba mi mnga' bar 'jug pa'i rten la rigs zhes bya'o/ / gsum pa la lnga/ rten chos bcu gsum gyi ngo bo dang*/ go rim dang*/ grangs nges pa dang*/ sa mtshams dang*/ rigs su 'gyur tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ sgrub pa bcu gsum gyi dang po 'jig rten pa'i nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa bzhi po rnams skye'o/

/re zhig ni rim pa ltar ston pa'i tshig phrad do/ /de'i 'og tu 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mthong ba dang sgom pa'i lam dag ste/ rtogs pa'i （ 61na ） chos drug go /sgom lam 'di sa bdun pa man chad kyi dbang du byas pa'o| |de'i 'og tu gnyen po de dag skyes pa'i stobs kyis spang bya spong bar byed do| |tshul ji ltar zhe na/ gnyen po bar chad med lam skye ba la phyogs pa dang*/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs 'gag pa la phyogs pa dus mnyam du'o/ /dper na rkun po phyir phyung nas slar ldog pa'i go skabs med pa dang*/ sgo 'phar bcad pa dus mnyam pa ltar ro/ /'grel pa 'di/ gnyen po dang ni spong ba dang*/ /zhes pa gnyis ka'i 'grel par sbyar te/ gnyen pos spang bya spong tshul phyogs cig tu bstan pas so/ kha cig spang ba dang*/ zhes pas rnam grol lam bstan pa bkag nas spangs pa'i cha la 'dod pa ni shin tu yang ma 'grel te/ de ni 'dus ma byas yin pas rten chos sgrub par mi rung ba'i phyir ro/ /de'i 'og tu de dag skye ba dang 'gag par zhen pa dang ldan pa'i rnam par rtog pa shes sgrib spangs pa'i sgrub pa skye'o| |gang gis spong zhe na/ spang gnyen de dag bden par mi dmigs par mngon sum du rtogs pas so/ /de dag gi gnyen pos spang bya ji ltar spong zhing spangs pa'i dus rnams bstan to/ /de ltar skyon bsal nas yon tan mngon du byed tshul ston pa ni/ de'i 'og tu 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa la blang dor du zhen nas mi gnas pa'i mtshan nyid kyi shes rab dang thabs kyi sgrub pa skye'o| |ci'i phyir zhe na/ sngon gyi smon lam dang sbyin pa la sogs pa thabs la mkhas pa'i stobs kyis so/ /de'i 'og tu nyan thos la sogs pa dang thun mong ma yin pa'i chos thabs shes zung 'brel gyi sgrub pa skye'o/ /de yang gang gis bskyed ce na/ thabs shes khyad par can de dag skyes pas so/ /de dag gis rang rgyud kyi yon tan mngon du byed tshul bstan to/

/de'i 'og tu gzhan gyi don gyi go rim gyi sgrub pa skye'o/ /gzhan don gyi ngo bo gang zhe na/ theg pa gsum gyi lam la 'god pa'i mtshan nyid can no/ /ji ltar na gdul bya'i bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du'o// thabs gang gi sgo nas zhe na/ gzhug pa la sogs pa la ldem por dgongs pa'i sgo nas so/ /dgongs ldem dgongs kyi ngo bo ni gang*/ khyad par ni ji lta bu zhe na/ de la dgongs pa can bzhi dang ldem por dgongs pa bzhi ste brgyad do/ /dang po bzhi ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ mnyam pa nyid dang don gzhan dang*/ /de bzhin du ni dus gzhan dang*/ /gang zag gi ni bsam pa la/ /dgongs pa rnam pa bzhir shes bya zhes gang gsungs pa ltararo/ /phyi ma bzhi ni/ rgyan las/ gzhugs pa ldem por dgongs pa dang*/ /mtshan nyid ldem por dgongs pa gzhan/ /gnyen po ldem por dgongs pa dang*/ /bsgyur pa ldem por dgongs pa ste/ zhes gang gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de la mnyam pa nyid la dgongs pa ni/ sangs rgyas la brnyas pa'i gnyen por mnyam pa nyid gsum la （ 61ba ） dgongs nas/ nga nyid de'i tshe yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs su gyur to/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /mnyam pa nyid gsum ni/ rgyu tshogs gnyis dang*/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku dang*/ gzhan don 'phrin las mnyam pa ste/ mdzod las/ tshogs dang chos kyi sku dag dang*/ /'gro ba'i don ni spyod pa yi/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam pa ste/ /sku tshe rigs dang tshad kyi min zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /don gzhan la dgongs pa ni/ pha dang ma ni bsad bya zhing*/ /rgyal po gtsang sbra can gnyis dang*/ /yul 'khor 'khor dang bcas bcom na/ /mi de dag par 'gyur zhes bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /dus gzhan la dgongs pa ni| gang dag bde ba can du skye bar smon lam 'debs pa de dag bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /de yang shi 'phos ma thag tu mi skye yang dus gzhan zhig na skye ba la dgongs so/

/gang zag gi bsam pa la dgongs pa ni/ sbyin pa kho na mchog 'dzin gyi gnyen por sbyin pa la smad nas tshul khrims la bsngags pa lta bu'o/ /gzhug pa la ldem por dgongs pa ni/ phyi rol pa dag bstan pa la gzhug pa'i phyir du khur 'khur ba dag yod do/ /zhes gang zag gi bdag yod par gsungs pa lta bu dang*/ nyan thos kyi rigs can theg chen la gzhug pa'i don du gzugs sogs phyi rol yod par bstan pa lta bu'o/ /mtshan nyid la ldem por dgongs pa ni/ mdo sde dgongs 'grel las/ mtshan nyid gsum bstan pa lta bu ste/ sum cu pa las/ /ngo bo nyid ni rnam gsum gyis/ /ngo bo nyid med rnam gsum la/ /dgongs nas chos rnams thams cad kyi/ /ngo bo nyid med bstan pa yin zhes so/ /gnyen po la ldem por dgongs pa ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ sangs rgyas chos la brnyas pa dang*/ /le lo cung zad chog 'dzin dang*| |nga rgyal 'dod chags spyod pa dang*/ /'gyod dang ma nges ldog pa ni/ / sems can rnams kyi sgrib pa ste/ /de yi gnyen por theg mchog gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /bsgyur ba la ldem por dgongs pa ni/ yongs su grags pa'i tshig don zab mo gzhan du bsgyur te ston pa ste/ ji skad du/ snying po med la snying por shes/ /phyin ci log la legs par gnas/ /nyon mongs pas ni rab nyon mongs/ /byang chub dam pa thob par 'gyur zhes gsungs pa lta bu ste/ de la snying po ni sems kyi rnam g.yeng ngo*/ /med la snying por shes zhes pas ni zhi gnas bstan to/ /phyin ci log la legs par gnas zhes pa la/ gtsang bde rtag bdag de las phyin ci log ni mi rtag pa la sogs pa bden pa'i rnam pa la legs par gnas zhes pas lhag mthong bstan to/ /yun ring por dka' spyad kyi nyon mongs pas ni rab nyon mongs zhes pas ni snying rje bstan to/ /de ltar ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab bsgoms nas snying rje chen po'i （ 62na ） gzhan dbang du gyur na byang chub dam pa 'thob zhes pa'o/

/de yang rgyan las/ nyan thos dang ni ngo bo nyid/ /de bzhin nyes pa 'dul ba dang*/ /brjod pa zab pa nyid la ni| |ldem por dgongs pa 'di rnam bzhi zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'di gnyis kyi khyad par la/ kha cig dgos pa gtso bor ston pa ldem dgongs dang*/ dgongs gzhi gtso bor ston pa dgongs pa can no zhes bzhed la/ lotstsha ba chen pos ldem dgongs nges don yin la/ dgongs pa can drang don yin no zhes gsung ngo*/ /slob dpon shinta pas/ de la brjod par 'dod pa'i don bshad pa ni dgongs pa'o/ /bstan pa'i sgra'i dgos pa bshad pa ni ldem por dgongs pa'o zhes gsung ngo*/ /de'i don ni/ sgras zin gyi don gzhan du drangs nas smra ba po'i dgongs pa ston pa'i cha nas dgongs pa can yin la/ don de nyid 'khyog po'i ngag gis ston pa'i dgos pa 'di'o/ /zhes dgos pa ston pa'i cha nas ldem por dgongs pa ste ldem po'i ngag dang 'khyog po'i ngag rnam grangs su gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de dag las phyi ma legs par sems so/ /des ni gnas skabs kyi yon tan mngon du byed tshul bstan to/ /de'i 'og tu 'khor ba ji srid bar rnam rtog gi mtshan ma med cing 'bad med lhun gyis grub par gzhan gyis don gyi ye shes rtsol ba mi mnga' bar 'byung ba'i sgrub pa skye'o/ /gal te 'bad med lhun grub tu gzhan don byed pa sangs rgyas kho na'i khyad chos ma yin nam zhe na/ 'dir ni 'bad rtsol chen po la mi ltos par gzhan don byed nus par lhun gyis grub pa'i gzhan don 'byung zhes bstan te/ rgyud bla ma las/ sngon tshe 'phen pa'i dbang dang ni/ /rnam rtog thams cad bral ba'i phyir/ /de ni lus can smin pa yi// don du 'bad pa byed ma yin/ /zhes sa bcu pa las kyang gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni| 'di ni sgrub pa bcu gsum gyi don gyi go rim yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ sgrub pa bcu gsum po 'dir nges te/

bcu gsum po 'dis kyang rnam mkhyen don gnyer gyi skyes bu'i don thams cad ma tshang ba med par sgrub pa'i rgyu phun sum tshogs pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /kyang gi sgras ni gdam ngag bcur ma zad 'dis kyang zhes pa'i don no/ /bzhi pa ni/ tshig gsal las/ lnga pa ni mthong ba'i lam mo| |drug pa ni sgom pa'i lam mo/ /bdun pa dang dgu pa ni de dag nyid kyi bral ba dang bral ba'i thob pa'o/ /brgyad pa ni/ sa 'od byed pa nas drug pa'i bar ro// bcu pa ni sa bdun pa'o/ /bcu gcig pa ni mi g.yo ba nas chos kyi sprin gyi bar ro| |bcu gnyis pa ni skye ba gcig gis thogs pa dang srid pa tha ma pa'o/ /bcu gsum pa ni khyad par gyi lam rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro| |lnga pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' rnam pa bcu gsum gyi chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid kho na la theg pa chen po'i rigs zhes bstan to/ kho na'i sgras rigs dngos po ba yod pa gcod do/ / （ 62ba ） ci'i phyir rigs zhes bya zhe na/ sngar ji skad bshad pa'i sgrub pa'i chos bcu gsum gyi rten gzhir gyur pa'i chos nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rigs bcu gsum du ji ltar 'byed ce na/ sgrub pa'i chos kyis gnas skabs rtogs pa mi 'dra ba tha dad pa bcu gsum yod pa'i bye brag gis so/ /gzhung 'di don bsdur 'chad pa ma 'brel te/ rten la rigs zhes bya zhes pa'i 'grel pa yin pas sgrub pa'i rten du 'gyur tshul bstan pa yin no/ / gnyis pa la gnyis/ rtsod pa dang*/ lan no/ /dang po ni/ gal te chos kyi dbyings kho na 'phags pa'i chos rtogs par 'gyur ba'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir chos kyi dbyings de'i bdag nyid can gyi byang chub sems dpa' bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi rten rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs can yin na zhes pas ni khas blangs brjod pa'o/ /'o na ni de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' kho na sangs rgyas kyi rigs can ma yin par thal/

chos nyid de ni gang zag thams cad la spyir thun mong du gnas pa yin pa'i phyir/ des na chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid kho na la rigs zhes bstan to zhes pa ni mi 'thad do snyam pa'i skye bo blo dman pa'i ngor dogs pa bsus nas bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa phyed kyis rtsod pa gsungs so/ /mtshams sbyar 'di rkang pa gnyis kyi 'grel par mi bzhed pa yod kyang*/ slob dpon shanti pas 'grel par mdzad do/ /de yang snga 'grel gyi rigs can so sor ma nges pa dang*/ rtsa bas rigs so sor ma nges par rtsod pas gnyis ka yang rtsa ba'i don yin la phyi ma nyid rtsa ba la gsal zhing*/ snga ma rtsa ba la dngos su mi gsal bas rtsa ba'i don la gnas pa 'grel pas dngos su bstan pa'o/ /theg pa gsum gyi rigs ni tha dad du dbye bar rung ba ma yin par thal/ chos kyi dbyings la dbye ba med pa'i phyir ro/ kha cig na re/ theg pa gsum gyi rigs tha dad pa mi rung ngo zhes pa ma yin no/ 'o na ci zhe na/ sgrub pa bcu gsum gyi dbye bas rigs bcu gsum du bshad pa mi 'thad de/ chos kyi dbyings la dbye ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes 'dod do/ /'di ni yang dag pa ma yin te/ nyi khri snang bar ji skad du 'jam dpal gal te chos kyi dbyings gcig dang*/ de bzhin nyid gcig dang*/ yang dag pa'i mtha' gcig yin na de la snod dang snod ma yin par gdags so/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /zhes so/ /mdo gzhan las chos kyi dbyings la dbye ba med pas/ theg chen gyi snod dang snod ma yin par ji ltar gdags zhes gsungs pa dang*/ 'di khyad par med pas theg pa che chung gi rigs tha dad pa mi rung ba la rtsod pa yin la/ rigs bcu gsum la rtsod na snod dang snod ma yin pa zhes pa 'brel ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /rtsa tshig 'di 'phags seng la sogs pa'i 'grel pa phal mo cher phyogs snga ma'i gzhung du mdzad do/ /bud dha shrī ni rigs de tha dad pa yin nam ma yin zhes pa'i

（ 63na ） lan du chos kyi dbyings la dbyer med phyir/ /rigs ni tha dad rung ma yin zhes bstan nas/ 'o na rten chos sgrub pa'i dbye ba ji ltar brjod zhes pa'i lan du/ brten pa'i chos kyi bye brag gis/ /de yi dbye ba yongs su brjod/ /zhes bstan nas gnyis ka rang gzhung du mdzad do/ / gnyis pa la gnyis/ rgyu'i sgo nas rigs su 'byed pa'i lan dang*/ rten gyi sgo nas rigs su 'byed pa'i lan no/ /dang po ni/ theg pa gsum gyi rigs nyid du tha snyad 'dogs so/ /gang la na/ chos kyi dbyings so/ /ci'i phyir rigs zhes bya zhe na/ theg chen 'phags pa'i zag med kyi chos rtogs shing 'thob par bya ba'i phyir du 'phags chos kyi rgyu'i ngo bor rnam par 'jog pa'i sgo nas so/ / theg chen gyi rigs nyid du tha snyad 'dogs so/ /zhes tshig rnam par sbyar ro/ / zhes bya ba'i lan zhig kyang rje btsun gyis gzigs mod kyi zhes pas ni don la lan 'di 'thob kyang gzhung rtsa tshig gis zin par ma bstan zhes pa'i don no/ / dpe ji ltar nyan thos kyi theg pa la sogs pa rtogs pa'i mtho dman gyi rim gyis bdag med la dmigs pa na rang gi rtogs pa dang mthun par 'phags chos kyi yon tan thob pa de bzhin du'o/ /'di dpe ston pa la 'chad dgos te gzhan du na ji ltar dang de bzhin zhes pa'i tshig 'brel ba med par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /dpe sbyar ba mi 'thad zhes pa ni dpe don sbyor ma shes pa'i rang gnong tsam du zad do/ /'dir nyan rang la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa yod par bstan te/ skabs 'di'i rtsod lan gyi shes pa'i phyir dang*/ nyi snang las/ de la rtog pa dang rnam par rtog pa ni dngos po dang de'i mtshan ma la mngon par zhen pa ste| de med pa'i phyir chags pa med pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /yod par ma gyur ba nyid ni chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid do/ /des na 'dis ni chos kyi dbyings nyid 'phags pa'i chos rnams kyi rgyu yin pa'i phyir/

rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs sgrub pa'i rten yin no zhes ston par byed do/ /zhes gsungs so| |de la rigs ni dngos po dang de'i mtshan ma la bden par zhen pas gzung ba ltar gyi don med pa'i bden stong la bshad do/ /des na chos gcig bden med du rtogs na rigs pa de nyid la brten nas chos gzhan yang rtogs dgos pas chos kyi bdag med ma rtogs par 'gal te/ 'phags pa lhas/ gang gis dngos gcig de bzhin nyid mthong ba/ /de yi dngos kun de bzhin nyid du mthong zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de la rtsod pa snga ma ltar na sems can thams cad rigs la gnas par 'gyur te/ chos kyi dbyings rigs yin zhing de la dbye ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes brtsad pa'i lan du/ chos nyid la dmigs nas bsgoms pas lam gyi yon tan gong nas gong du khyad par can du 'gyur pa'i tshe de dang de'i rigs su 'jog ces pa'i don te/ nyi khri snang （ 63ba ） ba las/ ji ltar dmigs pa na 'phags pa'i chos kyi rgyur 'gyur ba de ltar rigs yin par brjod pa des na 'dir ha cang thal ba ci ste 'tshol bar byed ces gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'dir rigs la gnas pa ni lam gyi skabs kyi rigs la dgongs so/ /gal te rigs la gnas pa tsam la byed na theg pa gsum gyi rigs can dang rigs nges ma nges sogs kyi khyad par mi 'thad par 'gyur te/ sems can thams cad rigs la gnas par mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta na'ang chos nyid la dbye ba med pas theg pa gsum gyi rigs ni tha dad pa mi rung ngo*// zhes brtsad pa'i lan du/ brten pa'i chos kyi bye brag gis/ /de yi dbye ba yongs su brjod/ /zhes brten pa'i chos dmigs byed lam gyi dbye bas rigs tha dad du brjod do zhes bstan to/ /rten ni dmigs pa rigs dang*/ brten pa ni dmigs byed lam yin pas nyan rang gi lam gyis kyang rigs la dmigs shing de la brten pa yin pa'i phyir ro/

/gnyis pa la gsum las/ snga 'grel ni/ sla chos nyid go sla ba'i phyir du 'jig rten pa'i ngag gis sam tha snyad kyis snga ma las lan gzhan du 'jig rten la grags pa'i sgo nas ston no/ /rtsa ba ni/ rtogs bya chos kyi dbyings la dbye ba med kyang rigs tha dad du dbyer mi rung ba'i skyon med de/ rtogs bya chos kyi dbyings la dbye ba med kyang brten pa'i chos theg pa gsum gyi rtogs pa rtsal che chung gi bye brag gis rten chos nyid de yi dbye ba rigs gsum du yongs su brjod pa tsam yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'grel pa ni/ brten pa'i chos theg pa gsum gyi bsdus pa rtogs shing thob par bya ba tha dad pa gsum yod pa nyid kyis rten rigs de yang tha dad pa gsum nyid do zhes bstan te/ dper na nyer len 'jim pa gcig las mngon par grub cing rkyen me lce gcig gis so btang ba'i rten bum pa la sogs pa rigs gcig kyang rten pa sbrang rtsi dang li kha ra la sogs pa'i bcud kyi byed pas snod nyid kyis de dag de'i snod tha dad par 'byed pa de bzhin no/ /zla 'od du/ bgrod bya nam mkha' la tha dad med kyang bgrod pa po phye ma leb/ bya khyung nyi ma'i lam zhes tha dad par brjod pa bzhin no/ /zhes dper mdzad pa nyid don la 'grig go /cha5 sgrub pa'i dmigs pa bstan pa/ gnyis pa la gsum las/ snga 'grel ni/ sngar ji skad bshad pa'i sgrub pa'i rten byang sems kyi dmigs pa gang yin zhe na/ zhes dri bas mtshams sbyar nas lan du dmigs pa ni 'di ltar ston no/ /rtsa ba ni/ mdor/ gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad ni gang lags zhes pa nas/ rang gi mtshan nyid kyis stong pa'i chos thams cad la chags par mi bya zhing chos thams cad gnyis su med pa'i tshul du rtogs par bya'o/ /zhes bya ba'i bar ni sgrub pa'i dmigs pa'o/ /de dag gi don bsdus nas ston pa ni/ dmigs pa chos rnams thams cad de zhes pa ni spyir bstan pa'o/

/de yang dge la sogs pa yin/ zhes pas ni cung （ 64na ） zad phye ste bshad pa'o/ /'jig rten pa yi rtogs pa dang*// gang dag 'jig rten 'das 'dod dang*/ /zag bcas zag pa med chos dang*/ / gang dag 'dus byas 'dus ma byas/ /slob ma thun mong chos rnams dang*/ /gang dag thub pa'i thun mong min/ /zhes pa ni rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /de yang mdor bsdu na chos thams cad byang chub sems dpa'i sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i gzhir bstan nas de yang dge ba blang bya dang*/ mi dge ba dor bya dang lung ma bstan btang snyoms su bya bar yongs su bcad par bya'o/ /dge ba de yang 'jig rten pa'i dge ba dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba gnyis su bcad do/ / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba de yang zag bcas kyi dge ba dang zag med kyi dge ba gnyis dang*/ zag med kyi dge ba de yang 'dus byas lam gyi bden pa dang 'dus ma byas 'gog pa'i bden pa gnyis su bcad de/ snga ma snga ma las phyi ma phyi ma khyad par du 'phags pa'i tshul gyis nyams su blang bar bya'o/ /de thams cad kyang thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan gnyis su bcad nas nyams su blang bar bya ste/ 'dis ni blang dor gyi tshul dang dmigs rnam yid la byed pa'i rim pa bstan te rang gi rgyud la sbyor bar byed pa gnad du che'o// 'grel pa la gnyis/ tshig don bshad pa dang*/ dmigs tshul gyi mtha' dpyad pa'o| |dang po ni/ byang chub sems dpas sgrub pa nyams su len pa'i tshe re zhig ni rim pa ltar ston pa'i tshig phrad do/ /dmigs pa bcu gcig go rim bzhin du dge sbyong gi tshul nyid la sogs pa dge ba dang*/ srog gcod pa la sogs pa mi dge ba dang*/ lung du ma bstan pa'i lus kyi las la sogs pa lung du ma bstan pa ste/ so sor ma phye bar spyir dmigs nas blang dor sogs byed do/ /de'i 'og tu gsum po de dag nyid la 'jig rten pa la sogs pa'i rnam pa gnyis gnyis su sbyar ba'i dbye ba grangs bzhi yod pa nyid kyis dbye ba lhag ma rnams la dmigs te rtsa ba'i grangs bzhin du de la 'jig rten pa'i rtogs pa ni byis pa'i skye bo thams cad dang 'brel ba'i phung po lnga dang zhes pa ni thog ma mtshon pa tsam ste/

mdo las/ phung po lnga dang skye mched bcu gnyis dang khams bco brgyad dang dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam dang*/ bsam gtan bzhi dang*/ tshad med pa bzhi dang*/ gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi dang*/ mngon par shes pa lnga la bshad do/ /'jig rten las 'das pa ni 'phags pa'i skye bo thams cad kyis bsdus pa'i bsam gtan bzhi dang zhes pa thog ma'i mgo smos pa tsam te/ byang phyogs so bdun dang*/ rnam thar sgo gsum dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gsum dang*/ dbang po gsum dang*/ mthar gnas brgyad dang*/ snyoms 'jug dgu la bshad do| |zag bcas ni gang zag gi bdag tu lta ba'i gnyen po ma yin pa nyid kyis nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga dang*/ khams bco brgyad dang skye mched bcu gnyis dang bsam gtan bzhi dang tshad med bzhi dang gzugs med bzhi rnams la bshad do/ / （ 64ba ） zag med ni gang zag gi bdag der lta ba'i gnyen po dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi dang*/ yang dag par spong ba 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam mo/ /de la kun las btus las/ zag pa de'i bdag nyid dang*/ zag pa dang 'brel ba dang*/ zag pas bcings pa dang*/ zag pa'i rjes su 'brel ba dang*| zag pa'i rjes su mthun pa dang*/ zag pa'i rgyu las byung ba'i phyir zag pa dang bcas par lta'o/ /zhes zag pa'i sgo drug gang rung 'brel ma 'brel dang*/ mdzod las/ dmigs pa dang mtshungs ldan gang rung gi sgo nas zag pa rgyas su rung mi rung la bshad kyang 'dir ni bdag lta'i gnyen po byed mi byed la bshad do| |'dus byas ni rgyu dang rkyen las rag las pa 'dod pa'i khams la sogs pa ste gzugs kyi khams dang zhes pa nas ma 'dres pa'i bar la bshad de kun rdzob bden pa dang 'dus ma byas ni rgyu la mi ltos pa de bzhin nyid dang*/ so sor brtags 'gog dang*/ so sor brtags min gyi 'gog pa dang nam mkha' rnams la bshad do/ /thun mong ba ni 'phags pa'i skye bo thams cad kyi rgyud la 'byung ba'i bsam gtan bzhi dang*/

tshad med bzhi dang*/ gzugs med bzhi dang*/ mngon shes lnga'o/ /thun mong ma yin pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyud la 'byung ba'i chos can stobs bcu la sogs pa'o/ /de lta bu la sogs pa'i chos thams cad theg chen sgrub pa'i dmigs pa yin te/ bden gnyis kyi gnas lugs ji lta ba bzhin rtogs pa'i rim gyis dmigs pas na/ dmigs pa rnam pa bcu gcig go /'di dmigs pa chos rnams thams cad zhes pa'i 'grel pa'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ 'grel chen las/ gang dag chos kyi dbyings rtag tu rnam par dag pa gnyis su med pa'i ye shes nyid ni dmigs pa yin no snyam du sems pa zhes rnam rig pa'i 'dod pa bkod nas/ de dag gis rtag tu rnam par dag pa nyid yin pa'i phyir/ gong nas gong du rnam par dag par khyad par du 'gro ba ji ltar brjod par bya zhes pas gnod byed bstan to/ /de'i don ni sems tsam pa gang dag chos nyid yongs grub dang*/ rnam par shes pa gzhan dbang don dam par grub pa sgrub pa'i dmigs pa yin no/ /zhes zer ro/ /chos nyid sngar dri ma dang bcas pa yin pa la phyis rnam par dag pa gong nas gong du 'gror med par 'gyur te/ chos nyid de rtag tu rnam par dag pa bden grub nyid yin pa'i phyir ro| khyab pa yod de/ dri bcas su bden na rnam pa thams cad du dri bcas su gnas dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /rtsa she las/ rang bzhin gzhan du 'gyur ba ni/ / nam yang 'thad pa ma yin no zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de la 'grel chen las/ chu khams gser dang nam mkha' rnams/ /dag pa bzhin du dag par brjod ces bya ba yin no/ /zhe na/ zhes pas ni sems tsam pa'i skyon spong bstan to/ / de'i lan du/ de lta na ni dag pa ni de kho na nyid kyi ye shes yin no// zhes gnyen po'i phyogs la （ 65na ） mngon par zhen pa'i phyir mi mthun pa'i phyogs la mngon par zhen pa don gyis 'phangs pa yin no/ /de bas na mi mthun pa dang gnyen po'i phyogs gyi rnam par rtog pa spangs pa med pas phyogs gcig pa'i dag par thal bar 'gyur ro zhes so/

/de'i don ni/ chu dang gser dag ngo bo dag pa yin kyang rnyog ma dang g.ya' la sogs pa dag pa bzhin du/ don dam par dag pa yin yang lam sgom pa'i stobs kyi rim gyis dag pa gong nas gong du 'gror yod do zhe na/ de lta na rtag gcig rang dbang can gyi bdag med pa tsam dang*| gzung 'dzin rdzas tha dad du bden par med pa tsam rtogs pa'i ye shes bden no zhes gnyen po'i phyogs la bden par mngon par zhen pa'i phyir na/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs la bden par mngon par zhen pa yang don gyis 'phangs pa yin no/ /des na spang gnyen la bden zhen gyi rnam par rtog pa spangs pa med pas dag pa phyogs gcig par 'gyur gyi sgrib pa mtha' dag spangs pa'i dag par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes bya ba'o/ / dbu ma pa rang la yang mtshungs so zhes brtsad pa'i lan du/ 'grel chen las| khyed kyi phyogs ltar na yang rab 'byor rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi dmigs pa ni dngos po med pa yin no/ /zhes bya bas dmigs pa mthar thug pa ji ltar yin zhe na/ nyes pa med de/ gang gi phyir rigs pa'i rjes su 'gro ba'i dngos po med pa yin pa'i phyir na/ dngos po med pa ni/ yang dag pa'i kun rdzob yin par brjod la/ de kho na nyid kyi rang bzhin sgrib pa de rim gyis sgyu ma lta bur rtogs pa ni rnam par dag pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ khyed dbu ma pa ltar na yang dngos po rang bzhin gyis med pa rnam mkhyen gyi dmigs par khas blangs pa de lta na dngos po med par 'gyur bas sgrib pa mtha' dag dang bral ba'i dag par mi 'gyur bar mtshungs so zhe na/ mi mtshungs te de kho na nyid dpyod byed kyi rigs pas dpyad pa'i tshe bden par med pa dmigs par khas blangs mod kyi dngos po ci yang med pa khas ma blangs pa'i phyir ro/ /bden par med kyang yang dag kun rdzob tu yod pa'i phyir chad par thal bar mi 'gyur ro/ / gzhan dag sems tsam pas gzung 'dzin gnyis stong gi de kho na nyid med dgag tsam dmigs par khas blangs pa la dmigs pa gong nas gong du 'gror med pa'i skyon brjod nas/

dbu ma pa rang la mtshungs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes brtsad pa'i lan du mi mtshungs te/ ma yin dgag sgyu ma lta bu la dmigs pas/ /skyon med do zhes mgrin gcig tu smra bar byed do/ /de ni dbu sems gnyis ka'i lugs las phyi rol tu gyur pa yin te/ dbu sems gnyis kas kyang chos nyid med dgag sgrub pa'i dmigs par khas len pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan du na stong pa nyid la dmigs sam ma dmigs/ dmigs na sems tsam pa la brjod pa'i skyon rang nyid la yang mtshungs par 'gyur bar （ 65ba ） khas blangs so/ /ma dmigs na rigs pas stong pa nyid gtan la phab pa'i dgos pa yang med par 'gyur ro/ /'phags seng gi lugs las yang phyi rol tu gyur pa yin te/ de dag gi 'grel pa dag las/ de ltar byas na rang bzhin gtso bor gyur pa sems can gyi rgyud kyi sems bden pa'i rang bzhin med pa nyid

ni rigs yin la rnam 'gyur gtso bor gyur pa bden pa'i rang bzhin med pa'i skye sogs sgyu ma lta bu ni dmigs pa yin te/ rigs dang dmigs pa gnyis ka yang gnyis kar ma bkag pa ste gzhi mthun du yod pa des na rten dang dmigs pa dag gi mtshan nyid kyi dbye ba dang dmigs pa dag pa'i mthar thug par 'gro ba yang 'thad par 'gyur ro/ /zhes chos nyid la dmigs par yang gsal bar gsungs so/ /'di ni mnyam med chen po rje rin po che'i blo gros 'khrul ba'i dri ma mtha' dag dang bral bas rgya 'grel gyi don khong du chud pa'i legs par bshad pa'i gtam bdag gis yi ger bkod pa ste ngo mtshar che ba'i gtam ni/ dper na byang chub sems dpa' spre'ur skyes pa'i rabs bzhin no/ / gzhan dag gi blo la 'bab pa ni shin tu dka' ste dbu sems rtsod pa rigs pa shin tu phra bar snang ba'i phyir dang*/ dbu sems kyi brda' chad la shin tu 'dris pa gcig dgos par snang ba'i phyir ro/ /cha6 sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba bshad pa/ gsum pa la snga rtsa 'grel gsum las/ dang po ni/ dmigs pa de lta bu sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba gang yin zhe na ched du bya ba zhes bya ba'o/ /rtsa ba ni/ mdor | tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes bgyi ba gang brjod pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' zhes bgyi/ zhes pa nas/ chos thams cad la mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rlom sems su 'gyur ba med do/ /mngon par chags par 'gyur ba med de de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes bya'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis ni sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba bstan to/ /de dag gi don bsdus nas ston pa ni/ shes par bya'o/ /gang na ched du bya ba 'di'o/ /gang gi ched du bya ba yin zhe na/ rang byung byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi'o/

/gang gi sgo nas na/ chen po gsum gyis so/ /de yang gzhan don sems can kun gyi mchog nyid du byed pa'i sems chen po nyid dang rang don spong ba dang rtogs pa chen po dang gsum po'o/ / gsum pa ni/ ched du bya ba rnam pa gsum du shes par bya'o/ /gang gi ched du bya ba yin na/ 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams nyid kyi'o/ /gang gi sgo nas 'byung bar 'gyur na/ rnam pa thams cad du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob byar yongs su shes pa'i sgo nas so/ / gsum du 'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ chen po nyid gsum dang ldan pas ched du bya ba gsum du 'jog pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum po gang zhe na/ sems can thams cad sems can kun gyi mchog nyid du byed pa'i sems chen po nyid dang*/ spang bya ma lus pa spangs pa'i spong ba chen po nyid dang*/ rtogs bya ma lus pa rtogs pa'i （ 66na ） rtogs pa chen po nyid do/ /ched du bya ba yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ thob bya gsum po de nyid kyi dbang du bya ste/ de ltar sgrub pa la 'jug pa de'i phyir ro// bzhi pa la gnyis/ dri ba'i sgo nas mtshams sbyar ba dang*/ lan gyi sgo nas rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de ltar sgrub pa'i rten du gyur pa dang sogs pa dmigs pa dang ched du bya ba brjod nas yang yang smos pa'i sgrub pa de'i rang gi ngo bo gang yin zhe na/ gnyis pa la gnyis/ sgrub pa spyi'i rnam gzhag dang*/ so so'i rang bzhin bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ sgrub tshul gyi sgo nas gnyis su dbye ba dang*/ mtshan gzhi'i sgo nas bzhir dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ de la kha cig phyin drug la nyams len gyi mgo mig btod ma btod la 'dod pa dang*/ kha cig phyin drug gi mtshan nyid kyis dngos su zin pa dang ma zin pa la 'dod pa dang*/ kha cig mkhyen gsum gyi nyams len la lta ba'i nyams len dang spyod pa'i nyams len zhes 'dod pa sogs ni mi rigs te dpyad mi bzod pa'i phyir ro/

/des na thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi yul la thos bsam gyi spyir sgro 'dogs bcad pa'i sgo nas dge ba'i chos kyi rten te yul can gyi bya ba ni sgrub pa ste zhes 'og tu sbrel lo/ /de yang gtso bor thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs bcad pa'i nyams len ni spyi sgrub ces bya ba'am/ mkhyen gsum yul gyi sgrub pa zhes bya'o// gtso bor sgom byung gi nyams su len pa'i bya ba ni bye brag sgrub ces bya ba'am yul can sbyor ba'i nyams len zhes bya'o/ /de yang sgrub pa la thos bsam gyi sgrub pa dang*/ sgom byung gi sgrub pa gnyis su nges pa'i phyir dang*/ mkhyen gsum la shes bya yul du bstan pa'i phyir dang*/ sbyor bzhi la yul can nyams len gyi sgrub pa bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan du na yul ni rnam pa gsum po rgyu zhes sogs dang*/ 'dir yang thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi yul la spyir dge ba'i chos kyi rten can ces gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ re re zhing zhes gsungs pa'i khyad par yang bzhag par dka' ba'i phyir ro/ /rnam pa kun mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa la sogs pa mngon par rtogs pa sbyor ba rnam pa bzhi'i mngon par rtogs pa re re zhing yang pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi rten te yul can gyi bya ba ni sgrub pa ste zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ de ltar rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du| theg chen gyi sbyor ba'i lam ni go cha'i sgrub pa dang*/ mthong ba'i lam gyis bsdus pa'i sgrub pa ni 'jug pa dang*/ theg chen gyi sgom pa'i lam ni tshogs dang*| khyad par gyi lam gyi ngo bo nyid kyi sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid ni nges par 'byung ba'i sgrub pa'o/ /de yang mtshan bzhi ngos bzung ba'i sgo nas sgrub pa'i dbye ba bstan pa tsam yin gyi de dag tu nges pa ni ma yin no/ /de ltar ji lta ba bzhin zhes pa yang sgrub pa bzhi go rim bzhin du （ 66ba ） mtshan gzhi'i go rim sbyor zhes pa'i don no/

/sbyor ba'i lam la sogs pa mtshan gzhir sbyor ba yang lam bzhi rim pa bzhin du skye ba ltar sgrub pa bzhi'i go rim bstan to/ / des na 'di sa mtshams la sbyar ba ni gzhung gi don ma yin no/ /cha7 go cha'i sgrub pa bshad pa/ gnyis pa la bzhi/ go cha dang*/ 'jug pa dang*/ tshogs dang*/ nges 'byung sgrub pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ spyi'i don dang*/ yan lag gi don no/ /dang po ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ grangs dang de yi mtshan nyid go rim dang*/ /nges pa'i tshig dang sgom dang yon tan dang*/ /de dag rab dbye bsdu dang mi mthun phyogs// yon tan phan tshun rnam nges yin zhes bya/ zhes khyad par bcu'i sgo nas gsungs so| |de la rang don la ltos pa'i grangs nges ni/ rgyan las/ longs spyod dang lus phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ 'khor rtsom phun sum tshogs pa mngon mtho dang*// rtag tu nyon mongs dbang nyid mi 'gro dang*/ /bya ba rnams la phyin ci ma log pa'o| |zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /rang gzhan gnyis ka la ltos pa'i grangs nges ni/ rgyan las/ sems can don la rab brtson pa/ /gtong dang mi gnod bzod pas byed/ /gnas dang grol ba gzhir bcas pas/ /rang don rnam pa thams cad spyod/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gzhan don la ltos pa'i grangs nges ni/ rgyan las/ mi phongs pa dang rnam par mi 'tshe dang*/ /rnam 'tshe bzod dang bya bas mi skyo dang*/ /dga' byed legs par brjod pa de yi phyir/ /gzhan don gyi ni rang gi don yin no zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /theg chen la ltos pa'i grangs nges ni/ rgyan las/ longs spyod mngon par mi dga' dang*/ /rab gus gnyis la mi skyo dang*/ /rnal 'byor rnam par mi rtog pa/ /theg chen mtha' dag 'dir zad do zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /lam la ltos pa'i grangs nges ni/ rgyan las| yul rnams la ni ma chags lam/ /de thob rnam g.yeng sdom pa'i gzhan/ / sems can mi gtong 'phel ba dang*/ /sgrib pa rnam par sbyong ba'i gzhan zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/

/bslab pa gsum la ltos pa'i grangs nges ni rgyan las/ bslab gsum dbang du mdzad nas ni/ /rgyal bas pha rol phyin pa drug /yang dag bshad de dang po gsum/ /tha ma gnyis kyis rnam pa gnyis/ /gcig ni gsum char la yang gtogs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de dag drug gis ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi grangs nges bstan to/ / gnyis pa mtshananyid ni/ rgyan las/ sbyin pa mi mthun phyogs nyams dang*| |rnam par mi rtog ye shes ldan/ /'dod pa thams cad yongs rdzogs byed| |sems can rnam smin byed rnam gsum/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ gzhan lnga la yang sbyar ro/ /gsum pa go rim nges pa ni/ rgyan las/ snga ma la brten phyi ma skye/ /dman dang mchog tu gnas phyir dang*/ /rags pa dang ni phra ba'i phyir/ /de dag rim par bstan pa yin zhes （ 67na ） gsungs pa ltar ro// bzhi pa nges tshig ni/ rgyan las/ dbul pa 'dor bar byed pa dang*/ /bsil ba thob dang khro bzod dang*/ /mchog sbyor ba dang yid 'dzin dang*/ /don dam shes pa'i phyir bshad do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /lnga pa sgom pa ni/ rgyan las/ thams cad sgom pa dngos po dang*/ /de bzhin yid la byed pa dang*/ /bsam pa dang ni thabs dag dang*/ /dbang 'byor nyid la brten par brjod ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /drug pa rab dbye la/ sbyin pa'i rab dbye ni/ rgyan las/ don rnams gtong bar byed pa dang*/ /rtsa ba'i sems dpa' la brten dang*/ /lus dang longs spyod phun tshogs dang*/ /gnyis rjes 'dzin dang rdzogs byed dang*/ /de yang ser sna med ldan dang*/ /chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs gtong*/ /sbyin pa de 'drar yongs shes nas/ /mkhas pa yang dag sgrub par byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /tshul khrims kyi rab dbye ni/ rgyan las/ yan lag drug bzhi bsam pas zin/ /bde 'gro gnas pa sbyin byed dang*/ /rten dang zhi dang 'jigs pa med| |bsod nams tshogs dang ldan pa dang*/ /brdar btags chos nyid thob pa ste/

/sdom la gnas pa rnams la yod/ /tshul khrims de 'drar yongs shes nas| |mkhas pa yang dag sgrub par byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /bzod pa'i rab dbye ni/ rgyan las/ mi mjed ji mi snyam shes dang*/ /snying rjes chos la brten pa'i phyir/ /phan yon lngar ni yang dag bshad/ /de ni gnyis kyi don byed de| |dka' thub gtso dang kun tu ldan/ /de dag la de rnam gsum 'dod/ / bzod pa de 'drar yongs shes nas/ /mkhas pa yang dag sgrub par byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /brtson 'grus kyi rab dbye ni/ rgyan las/ dge la yang dag spro ba dang*/ /dad dang 'dun la brten pa dang*/ /dran sogs yon tan 'phel byed dang*/ /kun nas nyon mongs gnyen po dang*/ /ma chags la sogs yon tan ldan/ /de dag la ni de rnams bdun/ /brtson 'grus de 'drar yongs shes nas/ /mkhas pa yang dag sgrub par byed ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /bsam gtan gyi rab dbye ni/ rgyan las/ sems ni nang du gnas pa dang*/ /dran dang brtson 'grus la brten pa/ /bde ba skye bar byed pa dang*/ /mngon shes gnas la dbang sgyur ba/ /chos rnams kun gyi gtso bo ste/ /de dag la yod de rnam gsum// bsam gtan de 'drar yongs shes nas/ /mkhas pa yang dag sgrub par byed/ / ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /shes rab kyi rab dbye ni/ rgyan las/ shes bya yang dag rab rnam 'byed/ /ting nge 'dzin la brten pa dang*/ /kun nas nyon mongs shin tu grol/ /shes rab 'tsho ba legs bshad dang*/ /chos rnams kyi ni mchog yin te/ /de dag la yod de rnam gsum/ /shes rab de 'drar yongs shes nas/ / mkhas pa yang dag sgrub par byed/ / （ 67ba ） ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /bdun pa bsdu ba ni/ rgyan las/ dkar po'i chos kun rnam par g.yeng ba dang*/ /mnyam par bzhag dang gnyis kar shes par bya/ /pha rol phyin pa gnyis dang gnyis// gnyis kyis yongs su bsdus pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /brgyad pa mi mthun phyogs ni/

chags pa la sogs pa las grol ba ste/ rgyan las/ byang chub sems dpa'i sbyin pa ni/ /ma chags mi chags chags pa med/ /chags pa nyid kyang ma yin te/ /ma chags mi chags chags pa med/ /ces gsungs te gzhan la'ang sbyar ro/ /dgu pa yon tan la/ yon tan bzhi bstan pa dang*/ tshogs brgyad bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rgyan las/ sangs rgyas sras rnams slong dang phrad na rang gi srog kyang rtag tu gtong/ /snying rjes gzhan la len kyang mi re 'dod pa'i 'bras bu don mi gnyer/ /sbyin pa de nyid kyis kyang skye bo thams cad byang chub gsum la 'god/ /sbyin pa ye shes kyis yongs zin pas 'jig rten dag na mi zad bzhag /rgyal ba'i sras rnams sdom dang brtson pa'i rang bzhin tshul khrims gsum rtag blang*/ /mtho ris mngon par mi 'dod yang dag thob kyang de la chags ma bskyed/ /tshul khrims de nyid ces sogs sbyar ro/ /sangs rgyas sras rnams shin tu bya dka' de bzhin mi gnod kun bzod dang*/ /mtho ris gnyer dang mi nus pas min 'jigs pas ma yin phan ltas min/ /bzod pa bla na med pas zhes sogs sbyar ro/ /rgyal ba'i sras rnams go cha sbyor ba'i bdag nyid brtson 'grus dpe med byas/ /rang dang gzhan gyi nyon mongs tshogs 'joms byang chub dam pa thob par byed/ /brtson 'grus de nyid ces sogs sbyar ro| |rgyal ba'i sras rnams ting 'dzin mang ldan bsam gtan rnam pa thams cad sgrubs/ /bsam gtan bde ba'i phul gyis gnas shing snying rjes skye ba dman la brten/ /bsam gtan de nyid ces sogs sbyar ro/ /rgyal ba'i sras rnams de nyid shes bya gang yin mtha' dag rnam kun shes/ /mya ngan 'das la'ang blo yi chags rab ma bskyed 'khor bar smos ci dgos/ /ye shes de nyid kyis kyang skye bo thams cad byang chub gsum la 'god/ /ye shes sems can yongs su bzung bas 'jig rten dag na mi zad bzhag /ces gsungs ltar ro/ / gnyis pa ni/

sbyin pa rten dang gzhi dang ni/ /rgyu mtshan dang ni yongs bsngo dang*/ /rgyu dang ye shes zhing dag dang*/ /gnas kyi sgo nas mchog tu 'dod// tshul khrims zhes sogs gzhan la 'don pa bsgyur ro/ /bcu pa phan tshun rnam par nges par gyur pa ni/ phan tshun bsdus phyir rab dbye'i phyir/ /chos nyid phyir dang rgyu mtshan phyir/ /pha rol phyin drug rnam kun tu/ /rnam par nges par shes par bya zhes pa dang*/ de dag kyang sgrub tshul gyi khyad par dang*/ nges par 'gyur ba'i khyad par dang*/ gdon mi za bar bya ba'i khyad par dang*/ rtag tu bya ba'i khyad par dang*/ gtso che ba'i khyad par dang*/ tshogs gnyis kyi khyad par dang*/ yang dag par sbyor ba'i khyad par dang*/ 'bras bu'i khyad par te brgyad do/ /dang po ni/ rgyan las/ re ba med pa'i sbyin pa dang*/ /yang srid mi 'dod tshul khrims dang*// （ 68na ） thams cad la ni bzod pa dang*/ /yon tan kun 'byung brtson 'grus dang*| |de bzhin bsam gtan gzugs med min/ /shes rab thabs dang ldan pa yi/ /pha rol phyin pa drug po la/ /brten pa rnams kyis yang dag sbyor/ /zhes pa dang*/ theg bsdus las/ byang chub kyi sems la brten pas rten dam pa/ dngos po thams cad dpyod pas dngos po dam pa/ sems can gyi ched du dpyod pas ched du bya ba dam pa/ 'khor gsum du mi rtog pas zin pas thabs la mkhas pa dam pa/ byang chub tu bsngo ba dam pa/ sgrib gnyis dag par byas pas dag pa dam pa ste re re yang dam pa drug ldan du sgrub par bshad pa ltar ro/ / gzhan yang gzhung nas go cha drug ldan du bshad pa ltar ro/ / gnyis pa ni/ blo ldan rnam pa thams cad du/ /phung po skye dang mi skyo dang*| |rtag tu sgom par byed pa dang*/ /ting 'dzin nyams pa med pa dang*/ /bya ba 'grub dang lhun grub pa'i/ /bzod pa thob la nges par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gsum pa ni/ rgyan las/ mchod bslab yan lag bslang ba dang*/ /snying rje dge ba sgom pa dang*/

/de bzhin dgon par bag yod dang*/ / thos don ngoms mi shes pa dang*/ /sa rnams kun la brten pa yi/ /gdon mi za bar bya ba nyid/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ 'dod pa'i nyes dmigs shes pa dang*// 'khrul ba dag la rtog pa dang*/ /duḥ kha dang du len nyid dang*/ /dge ba dag ni sgom pa dang*/ /bde la ro myang med nyid dang*/ /mtshan ma rnam par mi rtog pa/ /sa rnams kun la brten pa yi/ /rtag tu bya ba dag yin no| |zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /lnga pa ni/ chos sbyin tshul khrims dag pa dang*/ / mi skye bzod pa thob nyid dang*/ /theg chen brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang*/ /mtha' la snying rje ldan gnas dang*/ shes rab blo dang ldan rnams kyis/ /pha rol phyin pa'i gtso bor 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /drug pa ni/ sbyin dang tshul khrims bsod nams kyi/ /tshogs yin shes rab ye shes kyi/ /gsum po gsum ni gnyis ka ste/ /lnga char yang ni ye shes tshogs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / bdun pa ni/ rgyan las/ snod nyid du ni byed pa dang*/ /tshul khrims dag la 'god pa dang*/ /gnod pa lan ni bzod pa dang*/ /don byed par ni 'gro ba dang*| |bstan pa 'di la 'dzud pa dang*/ /the tshom gcod par byed pa 'di/ /blo ldan rnams kyi sems can la/ /phan 'dogs nyid du 'dod pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /brgyad pa ni/ rin chen phreng bar yang*/ sbyin pas longs spyod khrims kyis bde/ /bzod pas gzugs bzang brtson pas brjid/ /bsam gtan gyis zhi blo yis grol/ /snying brtse bas ni don kun 'grub/ /bdun po 'di dag ma lus pa/ /cig car pha rol phyin pa yi/ /ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab yul| |rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid 'thob/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ / gnyis pa yan lag gi don la gsum las/ mtshams sbyar ba ni/ de rnams kyi nang nas/ dang po go cha'i sgrub pa gsungs te/ go rim bstan te/

（ 68ba ） thog mar go cha'i brtson 'grus kyi ngo bo nyid sngon du 'gro dgos pa'i phyir ro| |rtsa ba ni/ mdo las/ tshe dang ldan pa byams pa'i bu gang pos bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' zhes bgyi ba de la bdag kyang spobs so/ /zhes pa nas/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam par 'phrul bar brtse'o zhes smra brjod mdzad cing dbyangs rjes su sgrog go zhes pa'i bar ni go sgrub bo/ /de dag gi don bsdus nas ston pa ni/ bshad do| |zhes pa khyad par gyi gzhi gang na/ go cha'i sgrub pa gang yin de'o/ /gang gi sgo nas na drug tshan drug gis so/ /ji ltar na/ mdo ji bzhin du'o/ /tshul ji ltar du dbye na/ phar phyin drug de dag so sor te re rer yang sbyin pa la sogs rnam pa drug tu bsdus pa yis so/ / gsum pa 'grel pa la gnyis/ dbye ba dang*/ bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis| sbyin pa'i go cha bshad pa dang*/ tshul de gzhan la sbyar ba'o/ /dang po ni/ chos kyi sbyin pa dang*/ sogs pa zang zing gi sbyin pa dang*/ mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa sbyin par byed pa na nyer zhi tsam don du gnyer ba nyan thos kyi yid la byed pa la sogs pa spong ba'i tshul khrims dang*/ skye bo thams cad kyis mi snyan par smra ba nyid bzod pa sogs bzod pa'i go cha dang*/ theg pa chen po'i chos mtha' dag la 'dun pa bskyed pa'i brtson 'grus dang theg pa gzhan dang ma 'dres pa'i sems rtse gcig pa nyid kyi bsam gtan dang*/ dge ba bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar byed pa'i shes rab rnams go rim bzhin du thams cad kyang sbyin par bya ba la sogs pa 'khor gsum du bden par mi dmigs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i go cha nyid kyis nyams su len par byed pa ni sbyin pa'i go sgrub bo/ / gnyis pa ni*/ sbyin pa de bzhin du tshul khrims drug ldan du srung bar byed pa dang*/

bzod pa drug ldan du rdzogs par byed pa dang*/ brtson 'grus drug ldan du rtsom par byed pa dang*/ bsam gtan drug ldan du sgrub par byed pa dang*/ shes rab drug ldan du sgom par byed do/ /gnyis pa ni/ de ltar drug tshan drug gi go cha rnam pa sum cu rtsa drug yin te/ sbyin pa la sogs pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa so sor re re zhing yang drug drug tu bsdus pa na'o/ /rgyas par phye na de lta mod kyi bsdu na go cha'i sgrub pa rnam pa drug go /rgyu mtshan ni/ sbyin pa la sogs pa drug sbyin pa'i go char chos mthun pa'i phyir ro/ /chos mthun la kha cig sbyin pa drug sbyin par chos mthun pa nas shes rab drug shes rab tu chos mthun pa'i bar zhes don du 'dod mod kyang*/ sbyin pa la phye ba'i drug sbyin par chos mthun pa la chos kyi bshes gnyen 'chad pa ltar legs te/ sbyin pas phye ba'i nyams len rgyu gcig las 'byung bar 'dra ba'i phyir ro/ /cha8 'jug pa'i sgrub pa bshad pa/ gnyis pa la gsum las/ dang po ni/ de'i 'og tu/ gnyis pa 'jug pa'i sgrub pa gsungs te/ de ltar go bgos pa la 'jug pa 'byung bas so/ /rtsa ba ni| mdo las/ （ 69na ） sha ri'i bus smras pa/ gang po ji tsam gyis na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po la yang dag par 'jug pa dang*/ theg pa chen po la yang dag par 'dzeg par 'gyur ba yin zhes pa nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po la yang dag par 'dzeg pa zhes bya'o// zhes pa ni 'jug pa'i sgrub pa'o/ /de dag gi don bsdus nas ston pa ni/ shes par bya'o/ /gang na/ 'jug pa'i sgrub pa'o/ /gang du na/ theg chen la 'dzeg pa yin par ro/ /'jug yul lam 'dzeg yul theg pa chen po de gang zhe na/ mdo sde rgyan las/ dmigs pa chen po nyid dang ni/ /de bzhin sgrub pa gnyis dag dang*// ye shes brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang*/ /thabs la mkhas par gyur pa dang*/

/yang dag 'grub pa chen po dang*/ /sangs rgyas 'phrin las chen po ste/ /chen po 'd-i rnams dang ldan pas/ /theg chen zhes ni nges par brjod/ /ces chen po bdun dang ldan pa'i phyir theg chen zhes gsungs so/ /de yang rgyu'i theg pa dang*/ 'bras bu'i theg pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bsam gtan zhes pa nas 'khor gsum rnam par dag pa dang zhes pa'i bar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ ched du bya dang zhes sogs gsum mo/ /de gnyis gsum du bsdu ste/ rang don dang gzhan don dang gnyis don gyi dbang du byas pa'o/ /de yang bsam gtan sogs gsum dang*/ byams pa sogs gsum dang*/ ched du bya ba sogs gsum rim pa bzhin no/ / gsum pa la gnyis/ so so'i don dang*/ dka' ba'i gnas bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'jug pa'i sgrub pa dbye gzhi/ dbye ngo rnam pa dgu'o/ / 'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan/ 'jug yul theg chen dgu yod pa'i phyir ro/ /ci'i phyir sgrub pa zhes bya zhe na/ theg pa chen po'i rgyu 'bras kyi chos mtha' dag sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus kyis gnon zhing bgrod pa'i ngo bo nyid yin pas so/ /dgu po gang zhe na/ de yang rgyu'i theg pa dang*/ 'bras bu'i theg pa gnyis kyis rig par bya'o// de la rang don gyi dbang du byas pa ni theg chen gyis bsdus pa'i 'jig rten pa'i lam bsam gtan dang gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la nyams su len pa'i yang dag par gnas pa'i mtshan nyid can te zhes kun la sbyar ro/ / rang don rtogs pa phun sum tshogs pa thob byed sbyin pa la sogs pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang spangs pa phun sum tshogs pa thob byed mthong ba'i lam dang*/ sa bdun pa man chad kyi sgom lam dang*/ sa brgyad pa mi slob pa'i lam dang*/ khyad par gyi lam sa dgu pa dang*/ gzhan don gyi dbang du byas pa ni/ gzhan don mthar thug 'grub pa'i thabs byams sogs tshad med pa bzhi dang*/ gzhan don rnam par dag byed bden par mi dmigs pa stong nyid rtogs pa'i lta ba dang ldan pa dang*/

theg dman las 'byed byed phyin drug gi dngos po thams cad las 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa dang*/ gnyis ka'i don gyi dbang du byas pa ni chen po gsum gyi （ 69ba ） ched du byas la 'jug pa dang*/ gzhan don rdzogs pa'i thabs mngon par shes pa drug la 'jug pa dang*/ 'bras bu la dmigs pa rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dag la yang dag par gnas pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi sgrub pa'o/ / gnyis pa la gnyis/ bsam gtan dang gzugs med bye brag tu bshad pa dang*/ tshad med bzhi bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ rgyu dang ngo bo dang*| 'bras bu'o/ /dang po ni/ de la zhi gnas mtshan nyid pa grub nas de'i rjes su lhag mthong skye ba yin te/ spyod 'jug las/ zhig nas rab tu ldan pa'i lhag mthong gis/ /nyon mongs rnam par 'joms par shes byas nas/ /thog mar zhi gnas btsal bya zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /zhi gnas mtshan nyid pa'i rgyu yang sems gnas pa'i thabs kyi gtso bo yid la byed pa bdun no/ /de yang kun las btus las/ yid la byed pa bdun gyi bsam gtan dang po la snyoms par 'jug ste/ yid la byed pa bdun gang zhe na/ mtshan nyid rab tu rig pa yid la byed pa dang*/ mos pa las byung ba dang*/ rab tu dben pa dang*/ dga' ba bsdud pa dang*/ dpyod pa po dang*/ sbyor ba'i mtha' dang*/ sbyor ba'i mtha'i 'bras bu yid la byed pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ / gnyis pa la gsum/ dngos kyi don dang*/ dbye ba dang*/ phye ba so so'i don no/ /dang po la gnyis/ bsam gtan dang*/ gzugs med do/ /dang po la gnyis| rgyu snyoms 'jug dang*/ 'bras bu skye ba'i bsam gtan no/ /dang po ni/ yan lag gi sgo nas 'og sa las 'da' ba'i sems rtse gcig pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ skye ba gzhan du rgyu snyoms 'jug gi bsam gtan bsgom pa'i rnam smin dang rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bur gyur pa ste/ de yang tshangs ris nas 'og min gyi bar gyi sems can gyi rgyud kyi skyes thob kyi chos rnams so/

/gzugs med la yang gnyis las/ rgyu snyoms 'jug gi gzugs med ni dmigs pa'i sgo nas 'og sa las 'das pa'i sems rtse gcig pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa'o/ /'bras bu skye ba'i gzugs med ni skye ba gzhan du de nyid sgom pa'i rnam smin dang rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bur gyur pa ste/ gzugs med bzhir skyes pa'i sems can gyi rgyud kyi skyes thob kyi chos rnams so/ /yan lag dang dmigs pas 'da' ba'i khyad par la bsam gtan rnams ni zhi rags kyi rnam pa can du mtshungs pa'i phyir dmigs pa la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par med cing yan lag mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yod pas yan lag gis 'da' ba zhes bya'o/ / gzugs med rnams la yan lag mi 'dra ba med cing dmigs pa mi 'dra ba'i sgo nas 'dod pa las nges par 'byung ba'i phyir dmigs pas 'da' ba zhes bya'o// gnyis pa dbye ba ni/ bsam gtan bzhi dang gzugs med bzhi'o/ / gsum pa ni/ bsam gtan dang po la yang dngos gzhi tsam po ba dang*/ khyad par can gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rtog dpyod gnyis gnyen po'i yan lag dang*/ dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' （ 70na ） bde gnyis phan yon gyi yan lag dang*/ rtse gcig pa gnas kyi yan lag tu ldan pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dpyod pa gnyen po'i yan lag gi rtog pa las kyang 'dod chags dang bral bas rab tu phye ba'i sems rtse gcig pa tshor ba btang snyoms dang ldan pa'o/ /bsam gtan dang por rang sa las 'dod chags dang ma bral yang rang sa'i yan lag 'ga' zhig las 'dod chags dang bral bar nus pa'i phyir/ tsam po dang khyad par can gnyis yod do/ /bsam gtan gnyis pa sogs la ni ma yin te/ de lta bu'i dmigs pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /bsam gtan gnyis pa ni/ nang rab tu dang ba gnyen po'i yan lag gis rtog dpyod las 'dod chags dang bral bar byed cing ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i dga' bde gnyis phan yon gyi yan lag dang rtse gcig pa gnas kyi yan lag tu ldan pa'o/

/bsam gtan gsum pa ni/ dran shes bzhin btang snyoms gsum gnyen po'i yan lag gi dga' ba las 'dod chags dang bral bas rab tu phye zhing bde ba phan yon gyi yan lag dang rtse gcig pa gnas kyi yan lag tu ldan pa'o/ /bsam gtan bzhi pa ni/ /dran pa dang btang snyoms yongs su dag pa gnyis gnyen po'i yan lag gis bde ba las 'dod chags dang bral zhing tshor ba btang snyoms phan yon dang*/ rtse gcig pa gnas kyi yan lag tu ldan pa'o/ /btang snyoms gcig nyid phan yon dang gnyen po'i yan lag gnyis su mi rung ngo zhe na/ 'du byed btang snyoms gnyen po dang*/ tshor ba btang snyoms phan yon gyi yan lag yin pas skyon med de/ des na bsam gtan dang po la yan lag lnga/ gnyis pa la bzhi/ gsum pa la lnga/ bzhi pa la bzhi ste/ mdzod las/ dang po la lnga rtog dpyod dang*/ /dga' dang bde dang ting 'dzin rnams| |gnyis pa la ni yan lag bzhi/ /rab dang dang ni dga' la sogs/ / gsum pa la lnga btang snyoms dang*/ /dran dang shes bzhin bde dang gnas/ / mtha' na bzhi dran btang snyoms dang*/ /bde m-in sdug min ting 'dzin rnams zhes so/ /gzugs med la bzhi las/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched ni bsam gtan bzhi thob pa nas kha dog dang dbyibs sogs kyi 'du shes skyon du mthong zhing gzugs med la yon tan du mthong nas rags pa'i 'du shes rnam par bshig nas chos thams cad nam mkha' ltar mtha' yas so snyam pa'i 'du shes bsgom par byas pas gzugs can gyi 'du shes nub pa'i sems rtse gcig pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa'o/ /rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched ni 'du shes snga ma de nyid rags par mthong nas nam mkha'i yul can gyi rnam shes tsam gyis thams cad khyab par mos pa'o/ /ci yang med pa'i skye mched ni/ 'du shes de yang rags par mthong nas gzung bya ci yang med do snyam du yid la byas pas de mngon du gyur pa'o/ /'du shes med min gyi skye mched ni/ 'du shes

（ 70ba ） de yang rags par mthong nas 'du shes rags pa ni yod pa ma yin phra ba ni med pa ma y-in no snyam du mos shing yid la byed pa'o/ / gsum pa 'bras bu ni/ bsam gtan dang po chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen po sgom pa las dang po'i gnas gzhan gsum dang bsam gtan gnyis pa dang*/ gsum pa dang*/ bzhi pa rnams chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen po rnams bsgoms pas 'od chung sogs bsam gtan gyi skye ba 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug bsgoms pas ming gzhi'i phung po 'grub bo/ / gnyis pa la lnga/ rgyu/ ngo bo/ dbye ba/ sgra bshad pa/ 'bras bu'o/ /dang po ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ bde dang sdug bsngal de rgyu las/ /byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje ste/ /rgyu dang bshes gnyen rang bzhin la/ /byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje'o zhes gsungs pas/ tshor ba bde sdug gnyis dang*/ de gnyis kyi rgyu tshor ba btang snyoms te/ dmigs rkyen dang*/ rgyu rigs dang*/ bdag rkyen dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang*/ de ma thag rkyen sems gsal zhing rig tsam mo/ /gnyis pa la spyi'i ngo bo ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ brtan pa'i tshangs pa mi mthun spangs/ /rnam par mi rtog ye shes ldan/ /dmigs pa rnam pa gsum la 'jug /sems can rnams ni yongs smin byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar mi mthun phyogs gnod sems dang*| rnam 'tshe dang*/ mi dga' ba dang*/ 'dod chags rnams spangs pa'o/ / gnyen po'i khyad par rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes dang ldan pa/ dmigs pa'i khyad par sems can dang*/ chos dang*/ dmigs pa med pa la dmigs pa'o/ / byed las kyi khyad par ni/ sems can rnams smin par byed pa'o/ /so so'i ngo bo la| byams pa tshad med ni/ khyad par lnga dang ldan pa ste/ gnas dang*/ dmigs pa dang*/ rnam pa dang*/ ngo bo dang*/ grogs rnams so/ /de yang bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi dang*/ bde ba dang mi ldan pa'i sems can dang*/ bde ba dang ldan na ci ma rung snyam pa'i rnam pa can dang*/

ting nge 'dzin dang*/ shes rab dang*/ de dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems dang sems las byung ba'i chos rnams te rim pa bzhin no/ /snying rje tshad med ni/ dmigs pa sems can sdug bsngal dang ldan pa'o| |rnam pa ni sdug bsngal dang bral na ci ma rung snyam pa'i rnam pa can dang*/ dga' ba tshad med ni/ dmigs pa bde ba dang ldan pa'i sems can dang*/ rnam pa bde ba dang ma bral na ci ma rung snyam pa'i rnam pa can no/ /btang snyoms tshad med ni/ dmigs pa nye ring bar ma'i sems can rnams dang*/ rnam pa ni mnyam snyam pa can te/ khyad chos gzhan gsum byams pa tshad med dang 'dra'o/ / gsum pa dbye ba ni/ sems can la dmigs pa dang*/ chos la dmigs pa dang*/ dmigs pa med pa la dmigs pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'i sems can tsam la dmigs nas bde ba dang ldan par 'dod pa sogs kyi rnam pa can no/ /gnyis pa ni/ mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin can gyi sems can la dmigs pa dang （ 71na ） gsum pa ni/ bden pa'i rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu'isems can la dmigs pa'o/ /rnam pa ni bde ba dang ldan 'dod dang*| sdug bsngal dang bral 'dod kyi rnam pa can du 'dra ba'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang bde ba dang phrad par 'dod pa dang*/ sdug bsngal gyis nyams thag pa dang*/ bde ba dang mi 'bral bar 'dod pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa can gyi sems can ni sems can la dmigs pa'i dmigs pa dang*/ tshad med ston pa'i gsung rab ni chos la dmigs pa'i yul dang*/ de bzhin nyid ni dmigs pa med pa la dmigs pa'i yul du gsungs te/ rgyan las/ bstan pa rnams kyi de dag bde 'dod dang*/ /sdug bsngal gyis nyams thag dang bde ba dang*/ /nyon mongs can dang de dag bstan bcos dang*/ /de yi de bzhin nyid la rab tu 'jug ces gsungs so/ /gzhan yang phar phyin gyi mi mthun phyogs la dmigs pa'i snying rje sogs drug ste/ rgyan las/ bkren la brtse dang ma rungs pa la brtse/ /kun 'khrugs la brtse bag med rnams la brtse/

/yul gyi gzhan dbang can la snying brtse dang*/ /log par mngon par zhen la snying brtse'o zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / 'dod khams kyi bde ba la chags pa'i sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje sogs bcur yang 'gyur te/ rgyan las/ rab 'bar dgra yi dbang du song*/ / sdug bsngal gyis non mun pas bsgribs/ /bgrod dka'i lam du kun tu zhugs// 'ching ba che dang yang dag ldan/ /zas chen dug la mngon par zhen/ /lam ni rab tu stor gyur pa/ /lam gol rab zhugs stobs chung ba'i/ /sems can rnams la snying brje'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / bzhi pa sgra'i don ni/ sems can tshad med pa la dmigs pa'i phyir dang*/ 'bras bu bsod nams tshad med pa 'byung ba'i phyir tshad med pa zhes pa dang*/ 'di bsgoms pas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du skye bas tshangs pa'i gnas pa zhes kyang bya'o/ /'bras bu la gnyis las/ ma bsgoms pa'i nyes dmigs ni/ rgyan las| byang chub sems dpa'i gnod sems dang*/ /rnam 'tshe mi dga' gnod sems dang*/ /'dod pa'i 'dod chags dang ldan pas/ /nyes dmigs rnam pa mang la reg ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /bsgoms pa'i phan yon ni/ rgyan las/ tshangs pas gnas pas gnas pa yi/ /blo ldan rtag tu 'dod par skye/ /des ni tshogs rnams rdzogs byed cing*/ /sems can rnams kyang yongs smin byed/ / kun tu tshangs dang mi 'bral la/ /de yi mi mthun phyogs dang bral/ /bag med gyur kyang de yi rkyen/ /mi zad pas kyang mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las kyang*/ bye ba khrag khrig gtams pa'i zhing dag na/ / mchod pa rnam mang dpag med ci yod pa/ /skyes bu mchog la nyin re rtag mchod pas| |byams pa'i sems la grangs dang char mi phod/ /ces gsungs pa dang*/ rin chen phreng ba las kyang*/ lha mi byams par gyur pa dang*/ /de dag kyang ni srung ba dang*/ /yid bde ba dang bde mang dang*/ /drug dang mtshon gyis gnod med dang*|
|'bad

（ 71ba ） pa med par don thob dang*/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten skye 'gyur dang*/ /gal te grol bar ma gyur kyang*/ /byams chos yon tan brgyad 'thob bo/ /zhes gsungs so/ /cha9 tshogs kyi sgrub pa bshad pa las/ja1 tshogs kyi sgrub pa spyir bstan pa/ gsum pa la gnyis/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ mtshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtsa ba dang*/ 'grel pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gsum pa tshogs kyi sgrub pa gsungs te/ de ltar theg chen la 'jug pa'i sgrub pa byas pa la tshogs skye bas so/ /rtsa ba ni/ mdo las/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das go cha chen po bgos pa go cha chen po bgos pa zhes brjod pa bcom ldan 'das ci tsam gyis na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos pa zhes bgyi ba lags zhes pa nas chos thams cad mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis theg pa chen pos rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la nges par 'byung bar 'gyur zhes bya ba'i bar ni tshogs sgrub bo/ /de dag gi don bsdus nas ston pa ni/ shes par bya'o| |gang na/ rim pa yin par ro/ /gang gis na/ tshogs kyi sgrub pa yis so// de yang gang zhe na/ bsam pa snying rje chen po'i tshogs ni/ brtse dang zhes pas bsam pa khyad par can snying rje chen po bstan to/ /sbyor ba pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi tshogs ni sbyin pa la sogs pa drug ces pa ste de gnyis ni sngar bshad zin pa ltar ro/ /dngos gzhi zhi gnas dang lhag mthong dang zung du 'brel ba'i lam gsum ni zhi gnas lhag mthong bcas pa dang*/ /zung du 'brel ba'i lam gang dang*| |zhes pas bstan to/ /de yang zhi gnas ni sems dmigs pa la g.yo med du rtse gcig tu gnas pa yin pas sems rnal du 'jog par byed la/ lhag mthong ni don la yang dang yang du dpyod pa'i stobs kyis sgom byung gi myong ba thon pa yin pas rnam dpyod gong nas gong du 'phel bar byed pa'i yan lag go

/ rgyan las/ yang dag gnas pa la brten nas/ /sems las sems ni 'jog phyir dang*/ /chos rab rnam par 'byed pa'i phyir/ /zhi gnas dang ni lhag mthong yin| |zhes so/ /'o na zung 'brel du ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ zhi gnas kyi stobs kyis lhag mthong 'dren par nus pa dang*/ lhag mthong gi stobs kyis zhi gnas 'dren par nus pa phan tshun zung 'brel du sgom pa yin gyi/ sngar ma byang ba'i skabs bzhin du gcig bsgoms pas gcig shos kyi dmigs pa stor 'gro ba ni ma yin no/ / rjes sems can gyi don byed pa la thabs mkhas pa'i tshogs ni/ thabs la mkhas pa gang yin dang*/ zhes pa dang*/ lta ba ye shes kyi tshogs dang spyod pa bsod nams kyi tshogs gnyis ni/ ye shes dang ni bsod nams dang*/ /zhes pa dang*| 'bras bu lam gyi tshogs dang*/ dmigs pa mi brjed pa gzungs kyi tshogs dang*/ yon tan gyi rten du gyur pa sa'i tshogs dang*/ mi mthun phyogs spong ba gnyen po'i tshogs bzhi ni/ lam dang gzungs dang sa bcu dang*/ /gnyen po zhes （ 72na ） rim pa bzhin bstan to/ / gsum pa 'grel pa ni/ tshogs kyi sgrub pa rnam pa bcu bdun no/ /de yang sems can mtha' dag bdag sdug bsngal dang bral 'dod kyi snying rje chen po dang*| snying rje'-i dbang gis sbyin pas slong ba po tshim par mthong ba'i tshe 'di'i bde ba sgrub pa dang*/ tshul khrims kyis ma 'ongs pa'i mngon mtho'i bde ba sgrub pa dang*/ /bzod pa dang brtson 'grus dang bsam gtan rnams kyis ting nge 'dzin gyi bde ba la bkod nas gcig tu nges pa'i bde ba sgrub pa dang*/ shes rab kyis myang 'das la bkod nas gtan du ba'i bde ba sgrub bo/ /zhi gnas dang lhag mthong dang*/ zhi lhag gnyis zung du 'brel ba'i lam gyis dmigs pa thams cad la 'dod dgur dbang bsgyur ba sgrub par byed do/ /de ltar nyams su blang zhing gzhan la bstan pa'i gang zag des gzhan don byed pa'i thabs la mkhas pa'i khyad par dang mnyam rjes gnyis kyi sgo nas ye shes dang bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po gsog par byed pa dang*/

tshogs gnyis goms par byas pa la mthong ba la sogs pa'i lam gyi tshogs rdzogs par byed pa dang*/ de dag gi tshig don mi brjed cing dran pa gtugs pa med pa 'byung ba'i tshig la sogs pa'i gzungs kyi tshogs dang*/ yon tan mtha' dag sgrub pa'i gzhir gyur pas sa'i tshogs dang*/ mi mthun phyogs spong bar byed pa gnyen po'i tshogs rnams so/ /ci'i phyir tshogs zhes bya zhe na/ snying rje chen po la sogs pa ni chos can| tshogs yin te/ snying rje la sogs bcu bdun po 'di dag gi yang dag par 'grub pa'i ngo bos 'bras bu byang chub chen po 'dzin par byed pa'i phyir ro/ / tshul ji ltar du sgrub na/ sgrub bo/ gang na/ theg pa chen po'i don mtha' dag go / ji ltar chos mtha' dag bden par mi dmigs par rtogs pas zab pa'i lam gyi rim pa dang*/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa las mi 'da' bar sgyu ma lta bur rtogs pa'i rgya che ba'i lam gyi rim pa'i sgo nas so/ /mdor na byang chub sems dpa' lam nyams su len pa'i rim pa 'ba' zhig bstan pas go sgrub kyi skabs su pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi nyams su len tshul dang*/ 'jug sgrub kyi skabs su 'jug yul theg chen dgu dang*/ tshogs sgrub kyi skabs su bstan pa'i tshogs sgrub bcu bdun rnams nyams su len pa'i tshul rnams dang*/ khyad par du byams pa dang snying rje sbyang ba'i tshul rnams rang gi rgyud dang 'dres nges pa'i nyams len gnad du 'gro ba la bdag legs su 'dod pa rnams kyis 'bad par rigs te/ gzhung lugs chen mo la thos bsam byas pa'i dgos pa'o/ /ja2 gnyen po'i tshogs bye brag tu bshad pa/ gnyis pa la gsum/ ye shes dang*/ sa dang*/ gnyen po'i tshogs bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ /yul can ye shes dang*/ yul stong nyid bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ tshogs sgrub bcu bdun bstan pa de la bye brag tu ye shes kyi tshogs ni dbye gzhi/ dbye ba'i ngo bo ni nyi shu'o/

/'byed pa'i （ 72ba ） rgyu mtshan nang stong pa nyid nas gzhan gyi ngo bo stong pa nyid kyi bar yul stong nyid nyi shu yod pa'i bye brag gis so/ /de yang nang dang phyi dang de gnyis ka stong pa nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes gsum ni/ tshogs lam dang*/ sbyor lam dang po gsum na'o// stong pa nyid rtogs pa'i 'jig rten pa'i ye shes ni sbyor lam chos mchog chen po na'o| |chen po dang don dam pa stong pa nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes gnyis ni/ sa dang po gnyis par rim pa bzhin no/ /'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyis de dag rtogs pa'i ye shes sa gsum pa dang bzhi pa 'phen no| |mtha' las 'das pa dang thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid kyis 'phangs pa'i yul can ye shes ni sa lnga pa dang drug pa la'o/ /dor ba med pa stong pa nyid kyis 'phangs pa'i yul can ye shes ni sa bdun pa na'o/ /rang bzhin dang chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyis 'phangs pa'i yul can ye shes ni sa brgyad pa la'o/ /rang gi mtshan nyid dang mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid kyis 'phangs pa'i yul can ye shes ni sa dgu pa na'o/ /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid dang dngos po stong pa nyid kyis 'phangs pa'i yul can ye shes ni sa bcu pa na 'jog go /dngos po med pa dang rang gi ngo bo dang*/ gzhan gyi ngo bo stong pa nyid kyis 'phangs pa'i yul can ye shes ni sangs rgyas kyi sa la bzhag go / gnyis pa ni/ 'o na stong pa nyid nyi shu gang zhe na/ 'dir smras pa/ stong pa nyid ni dbye gzhi/ dbye ba'i ngo bo grangs nyi shur 'dod de/ chos can nyi shu yod pa'i bye brag gis so/ /ci'i phyir stong pa nyid ces bya zhe na/ chos can nyi shu po rnams rang rang gi ngo bo bden pas stong pa'i phyir ro/ /mig sogs nang gi skye mched rnams chos can/ bden par med de/ bden pa'i gcig dang du ma dang bral ba'i phyir/ zhes kun la sbyar ro/ /gzugs sogs phyi rol gyi skye mched rnams dang phyi nang gnyis ka dbang rten gyis bsdus pa rnams dang bden pas stong pa'i dngos po rnams dang*/

phyogs bcu dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa dang*/ rkyen las skyes pa 'dus byas dang*/ cig shos 'dus ma byas dang*/ rtag chad kyi mtha' las 'das pa dang*/ thog ma dang*/ bar dang tha ma med pa'i 'khor ba dang*| sbyin sogs dor ba med pa theg chen dang*/ rang bzhin 'dus byas 'dus ma byas kyi stong nyid dang*/ gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar gyi chos kun dang*/ chos rnams kyi skye ba sogs spyi dang*/ gzugs su rung ba la sogs pa rang gi mtshan nyid dang*/ rgyu rkyen ldan zhing tshogs pa dang*/ cig shos phung po lnga'i ngo bo dang*| nam mkha' sogs dngos po med pa dang*/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid ces bya ba dang*/ byed pa gzhan gyis stong pa'i stong pa nyid ni chos kyis gzhan gyi ngo bo nyid do/ /stong gzhi chos can ni/ de dag rim pa ltar bden pas stong pa nyid ni/ stong gzhi de dag gi stong pa nyid do/ / gnyis pa la gnyis/ spyi'i don dang*/ yan lag gi don no/ /dang po la lnga| |ngo bo dang*/ dbye ba dang*/ khyad chos dang*/ （ 73na ） 'pho tshul dang*/ sgra don no/ /dang po ni/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes la sogs pas yongs su zin pa ni/ sa zhes bya ste/ yon tan gyi rten byed pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa rnam pa bcu'o/ /gsum pa ni/ skye ba 'dzin pa'i khyad par la| sa bcu la rim pa bzhin 'dzam bu'i gling gi rgyal po dang*/ 'khor los bsgyur pa'i rgyal po dang*/ brgya byin dang*/ thab bral dang*/ dga' ldan dang*/ 'phrul dga' dang*/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi bdag po dang*/ stong gi bdag po tshangs pa dang*/ stong sum gyi stong chen po'i tshangs pa'-i tshangs pa chen po dang*/ 'og min du lha'i bu dbang phyug chen po rnams su rnam par smin par 'gyur ro// yon tan gyi khyad par ni/ sa dang po la skad cig gcig la sangs rgyas brgya mthong*| de dag gis byin gyis brlabs pa shes/ ting nge 'dzin brgya la 'jug 'jig rten gyi khams brgya g.yo/

zhing brgyar 'gro/ 'jig rten gyi khams brgya snang bar byed/ sems can brgya smin par byed/ skal pa brgyar gnas/ de dag gi sngon dang phyi ma'i mthar yang 'jug chos kyi sgo brgya 'byed/ lus brgya ston/ lus re re la yang byang sems kyi 'khor brgya phrag re ston pa ste yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis 'thob bo/ /de bzhin du sa gnyis pa la yon tan de dag stong 'gyur dang*/ gsum pa la 'bum dang*/ bzhi pa la bye ba phrag brgya dang*/ lnga pa la bye ba phrag stong dang*/ drug pa la bye ba brgya phrag stong dang*/ bdun pa la bye ba khrag khrig 'bum 'thob/ brgyad pa la stong sum 'bum phrag bcu'i rdul snyed dang*/ dgu pa la sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med 'bum phrag bcu'i rdul snyed dang*/ bcu pa la sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rdul snyed rnams 'thob bo/ / phar phyin gyi khyad par ni/ rim pa bzhin/ sa dang por sbyin pa'i phar phyin lhag pa sogs sbyor ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ yongs sbyong gi chos so sor ji srid ma rdzogs pa de srid du sa de yin la/ rdzogs nas ni sa gzhan du 'pho ba yin par shes par bya'o/ /lnga pa ni/ bhu mi zhes pa la yi ge bsnan pa'i nges tshig gis bshad na 'byung po dpag med 'jigs med byed pas sam/ yon tan dpag med gong nas gong du 'gro bas na sa zhes bya ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/ 'byung po dpag med 'jigs med phyir/ /dpag tu med pa de dag la/ /phyi phyir gong du 'gro ldan phyir/ /de dag nyid ni sar 'dod do/ /zhes so/ / gnyis pa la gnyis/ spyi'i mtshams sbyar ba dang*/ so so'i rang bzhin no/ /dang po ni/ gsungs so/ /gang na/ bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa nyi shu rtsa gsum mo/ /dgos pa ni/ sa'i tshogs la sa gang gis yongs su sbyong bar 'gyur ba'i chos gang dag yin pa de dag bstan pa'i phyir ro/ / gnyis pa la gnyis/ rgyu sa dgu'i yongs sbyong dang*/

'bras bu sa bcu pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /dang po la dgu/ sa dang po'i yongs sbyong nas sa dgu pa'i yongs sbyong gi bar ro/ /dang po la gnyis/ rtsa ba dang 'grel pa'o/ / （ 73ba ） dang po ni/ sa ni dang po 'thob 'gyur te/ /gang gis na/ yongs su sbyong ba rnam bcu yis so/ /de yang bsam pa dang*/ sbyor ba dang*/ bsngo ba phun sum tshogs pa'o| |dang po ni/ bsam dang phan pa'i dngos nyid dang*/ /sems can rnams la sems mnyam nyid/ /ces pas bstan te/ de yang rim pa ltar rang gi don dang*| gnyis ka'i don dang*/ gzhan gyi don gyi dbang du byas pa'o/ /gnyis pa sbyor ba ni/ zang zing gis bsdus pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ chos kyis bsdus pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ bdag nyid kun tu srung ba'i sbyor ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gtong dang zhes pa'o| |gnyis pa la gnyis/ rang bsdus pa dang*/ gzhan bsdus pa'o/ /dang po ni| bshes gnyen bsten pa dang*/ dam chos dmigs pa 'tshol ba dang*/ /zhes pa'o| |gnyis pa ni| chos ston pa dang*/ zhes pa'o/ /gsum pa bdag nyid kun tu srung ba'i sbyor ba ni/ rtag tu nges 'byung sems nyid dang*/ /bden pa yi tshig ni bcu pa yin par 'dod/ /ces pa'o/ /bsngo ba ni/ sangs rgyas skur 'dod cing yid la byed pa'o/ /tshul ji ltar du sbyong zhe na/ chos bcu po 'di dag brtse ba snying rje chen po dang*/ don dam par rang bzhin mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i sgo nas yongs su sbyong bar shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa 'grel pa ni| sa dang po rab tu dga' ba 'thob pa yin no/ /ci'i phyir rab tu dga' ba zhes bya zhe na/ /rgyan las/ byang chub dang ni nye ba dang*/ /sems can don 'grub mthong ba la/ rab tu dga' ba skye 'gyur ba/ /de phyir rab dga' zhes brjod do| |zhes pa ltar ro/ /gang gis 'thob nas/ rtsa 'grel rim pa ji lta ba bzhin bshad pa ni byang chub kyi gzhi thams cad la rang don yid la byed pa'i gya gyur med pa'i bsam pa dang*/

rang dang gzhan gyi dgos pa sgrub pa la sems can gy-i don du phan pa theg pa chen po'i chos mtha' dag 'dzin pa nyid dang*/ sems can thams cad la tshad med pa bzhi'i sgo nas byang chub tu sems rtse gcig pa nyid dang*| 'khor gsum du mi dmigs par bdog pa thams cad yongs su gtong ba dang*| theg pa chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mgu bar byed pa dang*/ rigs can gsum gyi ched du theg pa gsum du gtogs pa'i dam pa'i chos kyi dmigs pa 'dod pa dang*/ nyes pa du ma'i 'byung khungs khyim na gnas pa la mngon par mi dga' ba dang*/ rnam pa thams cad du bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku 'dod pa dang*/ thog mtha' bar du dge ba'i dam pa'i chos rab tu ston pa dang*/ dam bcas pa bzhin byed pas bden par smra ba nyid ces bya ba de lta bu'i mtshan nyid kyis chos bcus so/ /ci'i phyir yongs sbyong gi chos bcu dgos she na/ sa dang po'i yon tan rnam pa thams cad du rdzogs par bskyed par bya ba yin pa'i phyir ro| |tshul ji ltar du sbyong zhe na/ yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyu'i khyad par bcu po thams cad don dam par

（ 73ba ） ngo bo nyid mi dmigs pas khyad par du byas pa'i mtshan nyid kyis yongs su sbyong ba dag kho nas so/ / sa gnyis pa la gnyis/ rtsa ba dang*/ 'grel pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa spyir bstan pa dang*/ bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ / dang po ni/ tshul khrims zhes pa ste/ rmi lam du yang bcas pa dang rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho bas nam yang mi gos pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ sems can gyi don sgrub pa dang*/ dge ba'i chos sgrub pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ bsam pa dang*/ sbyor ba'o/ /dang po ni/ snying brtse che/ zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ byas pa gzo dang bzod| |rab tu dga' dang zhes pa ste/ /de yang rim pa ltar/ byas pa chud mi gsan pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ gnod pa la bzlog pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ phan 'dogs pa'i sbyor ba'o/ /gnyis pa dge ba'i chos sgrub pa la yang*/ dge ba la 'jug pa'i thabs bstan pa dang*/ brtson pas nyams su len pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bkur sti dang*| bla ma la gus nyan zhes pa ste/ sems can thams cad la 'dud pa dang*/ bla ma la ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ brgyad pa sbyin pa la sogs la brtson/ zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sa gnyis pa dri ma med pa 'thob pa yin no/ /ci'i phyir dri ma med pa zhes bya zhe na/ 'chal tshul rtsol ba'i dri bral phyir| |dri ma med pa'i sa zhes bya/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /gang gis 'thob na/ dge ba'i chos sdud pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ sems can gyi don byed pa'i tshul khrims dang*| sdom pa'i tshul khrims ste gsum dang ldan pa dang*/ tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i yan lag gzhan gyis phan pa byas pa dran pa byas pa chud mi gson pa dang*| gzhan gyis gnod pa byas pa bzod pa la gnod pa ji mi snyam zhing sdug bsngal dang du len pa dang*/ chos la nges rtog gi bzod pa dang*/ dge ba'i chos sgrub pa la 'gyod pa med cing spro ba dang*/ sems can blos mi 'dor ba skye bo thams cad la byams pa dang*/

mkhan po dang slob dpon la sogs pa dang gzhan yang yon tan can la 'dud pa dang*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis bstan pa'i chos ji lta ba bzh-in du sgrub pa dang*/ sems can gyi don du sbyin pa la sogs pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spro ba zhes bya ba de lta bu'i yongs su sbyong ba brgyad kyis so/ /tshul ji ltar sbyong na/ snga ma dang po bzhin du yongs su sbyang ba byas pa'i khyad par rnams pa mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i sgo nas so/ /ci'i phyir brgyad kyis 'thob ce na/ snga ma bzhin zhes pa'i don drangs te/ rnam pa thams cad du bskyed par bya ba yin pa'i phyir zhes 'dir yang sbyor shing 'og ma kun la shes par bya'o/ / sa gsum pa la gnyis/ rtsa ba dang*/ 'grel pa'o/ /dang po ni/ yongs sbyong de rnam lnga ste de yang bsdu na/ sangs rgyas kyi chos 'dzin pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing sbyong ba dang*/ spyod pa 'grub pa'i rgyu dang*/ nyes pa las ldog pa'i rgyu'o| |dang po （ 74ba ） ni/ ngoms mi shes pa'i shes rab dang*/ rnam dag gi sbyin pa gnyis te/ de yang thos pas mi ngoms nyid dang ni/ /zang zing med par chos sbyin dang*/ /zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas zhing kun sbyong ba dang*/ zhes pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ 'khor bas yongs su mi skyo dang*/ zhes pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni| ngo tsha khrel yod ces bya ba/ /rlom med bdag nyid ces pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sa gsum pa 'od byed pa rtogs pa yin no/ /ci'i phyir 'od byed pa zhes bya zhe na/ chos kyi snang ba chen po ni/ /byed pa'i phyir na 'od byed pa'o/ /zhes pa ltar ro// gang gis na/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis gsungs pa'i dam pa'i chos nyan pas ngoms mi shes pa dang*/ rnyed pa dang*/ bkur sti dang grags pa la sogs pa la mi lta ba'i byams pa dang snying rje'i sems kyis dam pa'i chos rab tu ston pa dang*/ rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing rten snod dang brten pa bcud kyi skyon kun tu sbyong ba dang*|

rang gi phan btags pa'i sems can rnams kyi mi mthun pa gnod pa byed pa la sogs pa 'khor ba'i nyes pa mthong bas gzhan don la yongs su mi skyo ba dang*| rang la ltos nas mi dge ba mi byed pa ngo tsha shes pa dang*/ gzhan la ltos nas mi dge ba'i chos mi byed pa zhes bya ba de lta bu'i yongs su sbyong ba rnam pa lnga pos so/ /tshul ji ltar du sbyong na/ snga ma sa dang po bzhin du snying rje chen po dang don dam par ngo bo nyid du mi rtog pa'i sgo nas yongs su sbyong ba byas pas so/ / sa bzhi pa la gnyis/ rtsa ba dang*/ 'grel pa'o/ /dang po la lnga sems dang*| spyod pa dang*/ yid la byed pa dang*/ gtong ba dang*/ rnal 'byor rnam par dag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ dben par gnas pa dang*/ 'dod pa chung ba dang*/ chog shes pa ste/ rim pa ltar/ /nags gnas 'dod chung chog shes dang*/ /zhes pa'o| |gnyis pa ni/ sbyangs pa yang dag sdom brten dang*/ /bslab pa yongs su mi gtong dang*/ /zhes pa dang*/ gsum pa ni/ 'dod pa rnams la smod pa dang*/ / mya ngan 'das dang zhes pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ bdog kun gtong zhes so/ /lnga pa ni/ yul la sems 'jug pa dang*/ zhen pa med pa gnyis te/ mi zhum pa dang lta ba med ces pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sa bzhi pa 'od 'phro ba can gnon pa yin no// ci'i phyir 'od 'phro ba zhes bya zhe na/ 'di ltar byang chub phyogs mthun chos/ /rab tu sreg byed 'od lta bu/ /de dang ldan phyir sa de ni/ /gnyis po bsregs pas 'od 'phro can/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /gang gis na/ nyan rang gi yid byed kyis dben pa'am| grong las rgyang grags gis 'phags pa'i dgon par gnas pa dang*/ rgyang grags ni/ mdzod las/ sor mo nyi shu bzhi la khru/ khru bzhi la ni gzhu gang ngo*| |de dag lnga brgya rnams las ni/ /rgyang grags de la dgon par 'dod/ / de brgyad dpag tshad ces bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /chos gos sogs rnyed pa ma thob pa la thob par mngon par 'dod pa med pa dang*/
